You’re likely referring to a **cloud‑synced productivity or note‑taking app** that keeps your data (notes, tasks, documents, etc.) up‑to‑date across all your devices. Popular options include:

| App | Main Features | Sync Across Devices? | Typical Platforms |
|-----|----------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| **Evernote** | Note‑taking, web clipping, OCR, notebooks, collaboration | Yes – free and paid plans sync automatically | Web, iOS, Android, Windows, macOS |
| **OneNote** (by Microsoft) | Rich note formatting, notebooks, integration with Office 365 | Yes – part of the Office 365/Windows ecosystem | Web, iOS, Android, Windows, macOS |
| **Google Keep** | Simple notes, reminders, voice memos, color‑coding | Yes – synced via your Google account | Web, iOS, Android |
| **Notion** | All‑in‑one workspace (notes, databases, wikis, projects) | Yes – real‑time sync across devices | Web, iOS, Android, Windows, macOS |
| **Apple Notes** (for Apple users) | Plain‑text, rich text, attachments, iCloud integration | Yes – iCloud sync for all Apple devices | iOS, iPadOS, macOS, iCloud.com |
| **Dropbox Paper** | Collaborative docs, checklists, embeds | Yes – synced via Dropbox account | Web, iOS, Android |
| **Slack (or Teams)** | Messaging, file sharing, channel organization | Yes – cross‑device app & web access | Web, iOS, Android, Windows, macOS |

**How it works:**  
1. **Sign in** with the same account on each device.  
2. **Data** (notes, tasks, files) is stored on the provider’s servers.  
3. **Automatic sync** updates the data in real time, so any change you make on one device appears instantly on the others.

**Choosing the right one:**  
- **If you need heavy collaboration:** Notion or Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) are strong choices.  
- **If you prefer a lightweight, quick‑capture tool:** Google Keep or Apple Notes are minimalistic and fast.  
- **If you already use a specific ecosystem (e.g., Windows/Office):** OneNote or Teams integrate tightly with that environment.  
- **If you value OCR and web clipping:** Evernote excels at capturing web content and recognizing text in images.

**Next steps:**  
1. **Identify your primary use case** (e.g., daily journaling, project planning, research notes).  
2. **Try a free trial** (most services offer a free tier) to see which interface and features feel most natural.  
3. **Set up two‑factor authentication** on your account for added security, especially if you’ll be syncing sensitive information.
